description: Clicks and impressions per product in Google Shopping for a date range, best first, read from Google's Merchant API Reports on demand — nothing is stored, so it is a question, not a sync. Each row has offerId, title, clicks, impressions and clickThroughRate. At most 92 days per call and 100 products; truncated is true when more products matched than limit, so narrow the dates or raise limit. Conversions are not included. Read-only: it changes nothing at Google and needs no arming, only a connected Google account. Use get_marketplace for what Google decided about the products (moderation), and list_ad_campaigns for spend and the sales the CRM recorded.

adapterId.description: The Google Merchant connection id from list_marketplaces / get_marketplace. Omit it when the workspace has exactly one connection; with several, omitting it is refused and names them.

from.description: First day of the range, YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive).

limit.description: How many products to return, best first. Default 25, at most 100.

to.description: Last day of the range, YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive). The range is at most 92 days.

name: get_google_merchant_product_performance
title: Get Google Merchant product performance
